patterns.note: Content elements are framed with a hand-drawn, sketchy border, giving them the appearance of being drawn onto a notebook page.
The primary display and body text uses a handwritten, marker-style font, creating a personal and informal tone, contrasted with a clean sans-serif for navigation.
A minimalist color palette of black on a very light, warm off-white background dominates, mimicking a pen-on-paper aesthetic.

As the user scrolls, the initial hero video and subsequent content sections (about me, work categories) scroll out of view, revealing a 'Thank You!' message and a character illustration that appears to be drawn onto the page.
Each major content block, such as the hero video, the 'about me' text, and the work category buttons, is treated as a distinct, self-contained unit, often centered and framed.

technique_notes: To achieve the hand-drawn aesthetic, apply a border style that simulates a rough, uneven line, possibly with a slight offset or multiple strokes, to key content containers like videos, text blocks, and buttons. This can be done using SVG filters or CSS pseudo-elements with background images.

Implement a scroll-triggered content reveal system where different sections of the page are dynamically shown or hidden based on scroll depth. The main content scrolls away to reveal a concluding 'Thank You' section, with elements appearing to be drawn into place. This can be achieved using JavaScript to track scroll position and apply CSS transforms or opacity changes.

Utilize a full-width hero video that plays automatically, potentially with different scenes or loops, and includes an 'unmute' call to action. The video acts as a primary visual anchor before the user scrolls to reveal more content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Handwritten display text is significantly larger than body text, with varied weights and sizes to mimic natural handwriting; navigation links are small and uppercase.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, but the hand-drawn frames around elements give an organic, slightly irregular edge rather than a perfectly crisp corner.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous whitespace around main content blocks and between sections, contributing to a clean, sketchbook-like feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its pervasive hand-drawn, sketchbook aesthetic, where all major content elements appear to be sketched onto a page with a marker. This unique visual language is consistently applied, making the entire experience feel personal and crafted.
